title: From rice-husk waste to selective BTEX adsorbents: modified MWCNTs reveal a co-adsorption swing effect and improve field monitoring
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8105-8118
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08675B, Paper
Open Access

Anh H. Q. Le, Hien Y Hoang
Rice husk – derived MWCNTs with tailored surface oxidation show selective adsorption of gaseous BTEX, with swing effects enhancing xylene uptake. Field tests (NIOSH 1501) outperform commercial activated carbon.
